# Kolavi Studio

> AI-native growth agency that builds high-performance Next.js websites, runs AI-powered SEO campaigns, and optimizes for AI search engines (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews). We help businesses dominate both traditional and AI-driven search.

## Services

- [Next.js + Headless CMS Websites](https://kolavistudio.com/services#websites): Custom Next.js applications with 95+ PageSpeed, sub-second load times, mobile-first, ADA compliant
- [AI-Powered SEO](https://kolavistudio.com/services#seo): Programmatic SEO at scale, on-page optimization, technical SEO, local SEO, Google Business Profile ranking
- [GEO: AI Search Optimization](https://kolavistudio.com/services#geo): Optimization for ChatGPT, Perplexity, Google AI Overviews with advanced schema markup and semantic authority
- [Lead Generation & Automation](https://kolavistudio.com/services#automation): AI chatbots, multi-step conversion funnels, membership upsell automation
- [Content Engine](https://kolavistudio.com/services#content): AI-assisted, human-edited blog content at scale with keyword-targeted guides
- [Reputation & Reporting](https://kolavistudio.com/services#reputation): Automated review generation, call tracking, lead attribution, real-time ROI dashboards

## YAML Tools

- [YAML Tools Hub](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools): All YAML tools and guides
- [YAML Validator](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-validator): Validate YAML with line and column error messages
- [YAML to JSON](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-to-json): Convert YAML to JSON in the browser
- [JSON to YAML](https://kolavistudio.com/json-to-yaml): Convert JSON to YAML with custom indentation
- [YAML Formatter](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-formatter): Format and beautify YAML, optionally sorting keys
- [YAML Editor](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-editor): Browser YAML editor with live validation and autosave
- [YAML Diff](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-diff): Line and structural diff of two YAML files
- [YAML Guide](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-guide): What YAML is, syntax rules, and how it compares with JSON and XML
- [YAML Syntax](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/syntax): YAML syntax reference
- [YAML Lists, Arrays and Dictionaries](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/arrays-and-lists): Block and flow lists, empty lists and dictionaries, nested lists
- [YAML Multiline Strings](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/multiline-strings): Literal (|) and folded (>) block scalars and chomping indicators
- [YAML Anchors and Aliases](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/anchors): Anchors (&), aliases (*), and merge keys (<<:)
- [YAML Comments](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/comments): Single-line and block comments
- [YAML vs JSON](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/yaml-vs-json): Differences and when to use each
- [.yml vs .yaml](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/yml-vs-yaml): Whether the two extensions differ
- [Python YAML](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/python): Reading and writing YAML with PyYAML
- [No module named 'yaml'](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/no-module-named-yaml): Fix for ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'yaml'
- [Kubernetes YAML](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/kubernetes): Kubernetes manifest structure
- [Docker Compose YAML](https://kolavistudio.com/yaml-tools/docker-compose): compose.yaml reference
